study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 1,538 pregnant women attending prenatal clinics who were part of the Tehran Thyroid and Pregnancy Study.
finding: Using a Bayesian method, a TSH cutoff of 3.97 mIU/L (95%CI: 3.95-4.00) was estimated for distinguishing pregnant women at risk of preterm birth, with slightly adjusted cutoffs depending on TPOAb status and urinary iodine concentration.
